name: revahub-module-database
description: Native database module for RevaHub — provides SQL query access

revahub.label: Database
revahub.description: Provides SQL query access. Uses embedded PGlite by default, or connects to external PostgreSQL when connectionString is provided.

options.label: Connection String
options.description: PostgreSQL connection string (e.g., postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db). Leave empty to use embedded PGlite.

options.label: Schema Prefix
options.description: Optional prefix for schema isolation (default: none)
